subject: Case study discovery interview — scheduling & recording consent (Aperture Health)
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@aperturehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Case study discovery interview — scheduling & recording consent (Aperture Health)

Hi Lena,

Hope you’re well — thanks again for agreeing to speak with us about Aperture Health’s work with Redwood. We’d like to schedule a 30-minute discovery interview to capture:

- Key business outcomes you’re seeing (latency/cost improvements, developer velocity, any specific feature wins)
- Primary stakeholders and day-to-day users of the integration
- Any metrics or quotes you’d be comfortable sharing in a case study

Proposed times (PST):
- Thu Mar 19, 10:00–10:30am
- Thu Mar 19, 2:00–2:30pm
- Fri Mar 20, 9:30–10:00am

If none of those work, send over times that suit you and Tomás. Two logistics notes: 1) we typically record these calls for accuracy and to pull short quotes — would you be comfortable with that? and 2) I attached a short intake form and a standard release consent we can send for signature after the interview.

Attached: case-study-intake-form.pdf (1 page), release-consent-template.docx (word)

Agenda (30m):
1) 5m introductions + context
2) 15m outcomes & workflows
3) 5m metrics/quotes review
4) 5m next steps + approvals

Thanks — can you confirm which time works and whether recording is OK?

Best,

Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@aperturehealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Tomás Rivera <tomas.rivera@aperturehealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 11:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Case study discovery interview — scheduling & recording consent (Aperture Health)

Thanks Sean — appreciate the outline. We’re happy to participate. Tomás (Head of Platform) will join and I’ll loop in our comms lead if we need approvals on quotes.

Thu Mar 19 at 2:00pm PST works for both of us. Recording is fine as long as the recording is used for Redwood internal notes and for pulling short, pre-approved quotes — we’ll want to review any quote before publication.

A few stakeholder notes:
- Lena Ortiz — Director, Data & Platform (me)
- Tomás Rivera — Head of Platform (will attend)
- Maya Li — Communications (may join or be on follow-up)

We’ll also bring the cost/latency dashboard export to reference.

See you Thu 2pm.

Best,
Lena

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@aperturehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 13:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Case study discovery interview — scheduling & recording consent (Aperture Health)

Perfect — thanks Lena, Tomás. We’re confirmed for Thu Mar 19, 2:00–2:30pm PST. I’ll send a calendar invite with a Zoom link and add a tentative 15-minute follow-up slot for approvals if needed.

Quick notes for internal folks (Monica, Jasmine):
- Monica: please join to lead the narrative and pull the right metrics.
- Jasmine: can you bring the draft quote templates and note the date we'll need formal sign-off by comms (suggested Mar 26)?

I attached the intake form and a short consent template again — Lena, if you could return the signed release after the call that would speed publication.

Attachments: case-study-intake-form.pdf; release-consent-template.docx

Agenda update: add 3 minutes at the end to confirm approval owners and timeline.

Thanks everyone — invite to follow.

Sean

From: Tomás Rivera <tomas.rivera@aperturehealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@aperturehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Case study discovery interview — scheduling & recording consent (Aperture Health)

Thanks — confirmed. Recording permission granted for the reasons Lena outlined (internal notes + quote pulling). We’ll review any quotes before they go live and aim to get the signed release to you by Mon Mar 23.

Also flagging one example we’ll pull in the call: the two-week rollout of the inference cache that cut average token spend by ~27% in our test cluster. Happy to share numbers from our dashboard during the call.

See you Thu.

– Tomás
Head of Platform, Aperture Health
tomas.rivera@aperturehealth.com
